sloka: क्षमा ते पृथिवीतुल्या तेजसा भास्करोपमः ।वेगस्ते वायुना तुल्यो गाम्भीर्यमुदधेरिव ।। ७.३७.६ ॥
transliteration: kṣamā te pṛthivītulyā tejasā bhāskaropamaḥ ।vegaste vāyunā tulyo gāmbhīryamudadheriva ।। 7.37.6 ॥

translations.english: Your patience is like that of the earth, your splendor is comparable to the sun, your speed is equal to the wind, and your depth is like that of the ocean.
